status: ProposedNotRun; original design vectors, not implementation tests
scope: Native views sidecar, identity and scoped histories; no semantic delete or external source admission

vectors.case: Reuse one native mission in two views, edit its name through existing command
expect: Separate layout survives save/reopen with exact native binding

vectors.case: Same native DocumentId but changed native artifact bytes
expect: Native model can open safely with default canvas

vectors.case: Native save succeeds; view save fails
expect: Native saved / views unsaved shown separately
Reopen does not silently mix generations

vectors.case: Late view-save acknowledgment after new layout edit
expect: Old request cannot mark newer view revision saved

vectors.case: Model Undo removes an added element used in a view
expect: Presentation becomes inactive detached state with exact geometry/ID
Active edges cannot target missing record
Matching same-instance model redo may reactivate after validation

vectors.case: Layout Undo while its native target is absent
Reopen detached presentation then add or discover similar-named record
expect: No automatic reactivation by label or numeric coincidence

vectors.case: Remove one of two same-view occurrences with an explicitly attached edge
expect: Undo restores original identity if target still valid

vectors.case: Persist routing for contributesTo, typed subject and forObjective
expect: Other graph links remain visible with derived/unpersisted route status

vectors.case: Request semantic delete from first-slice view menu
expect: Presentation remove remains available and distinct

vectors.case: Interleave native field/text Undo and view layout Undo
expect: No layout command edits accepted/raw semantic data
Unrelated layout action does not erase native redo

vectors.case: Recover native document with new DocumentId
expect: Recovered document stays dirty and independent
Original sources and presentation recovery retained

vectors.case: Future/unknown sidecar fields/profile or corrupt/missing sidecar
expect: Unbound/read-only status and default native canvas

vectors.case: Native RecordId beyond JavaScript-safe integer range or maximumu64
expect: Canonical decimal string checked against existing core RecordId
Presentation allocator never reuses retired ID
Refusal before partial view commit or large clone

vectors.case: View-only hide, move, pin, fit and save after evaluation
expect: Semantic quantity/reference edit still invalidates under existing evaluator policy
